description.narrative: IFC expects the Project to create jobs, increase business opportunities, and build the capacity of local suppliers, particularly small and medium enterprises. Beyond the Project outcomes, IFC anticipates that its financing will promote greater market competitiveness and sustainability in the tourism sector via competitive pressure and demonstration effects.

IFC will support part of the investment program of Adriatic Marinas d.o.o. (the Company), which includes developing a sports and wellness-focused hotel, food and non-food retail, a creative industry space, an outpatient clinic, and related infrastructure in Montenegro (The Project).
